turns.label: Patient

turns.label: Clinician

Or Prepatellar, or sorry, infra patellar bursitis or a prepatellar bursistis which are the kind of the more common types. One thing to make sure that we rule out would be a septic Bursitis. Although you're not having any fevers or chills so that makes it a little bit less likely.

But right now I think it's mostly sounding like a knee bursitis.
